login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your cameras.

setup.title: Welcome to Little Sister
setup.intro: Three short steps and you are ready.
setup.stepAccountText: You will use this account to manage cameras and users.
setup.stepStorageText: Little Sister stores recordings here. Pick a folder on a large disk.
setup.stepRegionText: Recordings are stored in UTC and shown in your time zone.
setup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A long sentence beats a short word.

home.camerasText: Add your first camera. Little Sister can find it on your network automatically.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Administrators can do everything, viewers can only watch and download.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: The server cannot be reached right now.
errors.invalidCredentials: User name or password is wrong.
errors.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for a few minutes.
errors.http429: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.absolutePathRequired: Please enter a full path, e.g. /recordings or D:\Recordings.
errors.notWritable: Little Sister may not write to this folder.
errors.PasswordTooShort: The password is too short (at least 10 characters).
errors.InvalidUserName: The user name contains invalid characters.
errors.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.setupAlreadyCompleted: Little Sister is already set up.
errors.rtspUrlRequired: Please enter an RTSP address, e.g. rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/stream.
errors.onvifUnauthorized: The camera rejected user name or password.
errors.onvifUnreachable: The camera cannot be reached at this address.
errors.onvifInvalidResponse: The camera does not answer like an ONVIF device.
errors.streamNotFound: There is no stream at this address.
errors.streamRefused: The camera refuses RTSP connections. Is RTSP switched on?
errors.streamTimeout: The camera does not answer in time.
errors.ffprobeMissing: ffprobe is not installed on the server.

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.subtitle: All connected cameras with recording status and storage use.
cameras.storageDaysUnknown: Duration is calculated after the first recordings
cameras.noneFoundHint: Check that ONVIF is enabled on the camera. When Little Sister runs in Docker, search only works with host networking. You can also enter the IP address directly.
cameras.enableHint: Tip: many cameras (e.g. Reolink) need RTSP and ONVIF switched on in their network settings first.
cameras.name: Name
cameras.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
cameras.hevcHint: H.265 is recorded without conversion. For live view in the browser Little Sister uses the sub stream.
cameras.recordingHint: Records around the clock. Recording on motion only (camera event via ONVIF) follows in a later step.
cameras.recordingOffHint: Off: this camera records nothing. Recording on motion only is not available yet.
cameras.quotaHint: When full, the oldest recordings of this camera are deleted.
cameras.retentionHint: Optional, e.g. for privacy. Older recordings are deleted even if space is left.
cameras.deleteRecordings: Also delete all recordings of this camera?

storage.title: Storage
storage.minFreeHint: Below this, Little Sister deletes the oldest recordings of all cameras.
storage.pathHint: Little Sister stores new recordings here.
storage.pathChangeHint: New recordings go to the new folder. Existing ones stay in the previous folder and are still managed and deleted there.
